title: Synthetic Lattice Dynamics of Quasi-Periodic Crystals
abstract: We study synthetic lattice dynamics of quasi-periodic crystals using harmonic approximations.

title: Synthetic Protein Folding Landscapes under Confinement
abstract: We map synthetic folding landscapes under nanoscale confinement.

title: Synthetic Graph Kernels for Molecular Property Predictions
abstract: We propose synthetic graph kernels evaluated on large-scale molecular property prediction benchmarks with uncertainty calibration.
